result.instructions: Tools for Axcient, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which of our protected devices have failed backups in the last 7 days?"; "Show the latest restore point for the server of client Acme."; "How much cloud storage does each client use?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Axcient data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run axcient_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run axcient_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run axcient_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. axcient_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: axcient_get_organization
tools.title: Get organization
tools.description: Return the partner organization that the API key belongs to. Use it to confirm the connection. Axcient API: GET /organization.

tools.name: axcient_list_clients
tools.title: List clients
tools.description: List the clients (customer accounts) of the partner organization, with their health status and device counters. Start here to find a client_id. Axcient API: GET /client.

include_appliances.description: Include the appliances in each result.

tools.name: axcient_get_client
tools.title: Get client
tools.description: Return one client by its id. Axcient API: GET /client/{client_id}.

include_appliances.description: Include the appliances in each result.

tools.name: axcient_get_client_usage
tools.title: Get client storage usage
tools.description: Return the local, vault and cloud storage usage of one client. Axcient API: GET /client/{client_id}/usage.

tools.name: axcient_list_appliances
tools.title: List appliances
tools.description: List the x360Recover appliances (on-premise backup servers) of the organization. Axcient API: GET /appliance.

service_id.description: Filter by the 4-character appliance service serial number.

include_devices.description: Include the devices in each result.

tools.name: axcient_get_appliance
tools.title: Get appliance
tools.description: Return one appliance by its id. Axcient API: GET /appliance/{appliance_id}.

include_devices.description: Include the devices in each result.

tools.name: axcient_list_vaults
tools.title: List vaults
tools.description: List the vaults of the organization, with health status, storage use and replicated devices. Axcient API: GET /vault.

include_devices.description: Include the devices in each result.

tools.name: axcient_get_vault
tools.title: Get vault
tools.description: Return one vault by its id, with its health, storage and devices. Axcient API: GET /vault/{vault_id}.

tools.name: axcient_get_vault_connectivity_threshold
tools.title: Get vault connectivity threshold
tools.description: Return the connectivity threshold that the vault uses for its alerts. Read only: this tool does not change it. Axcient API: GET /vault/{vault_id}/threshold/connectivity.

tools.name: axcient_list_devices
tools.title: List devices
tools.description: List the protected devices (servers, workstations) of the organization, with health status, usage and vaults. Axcient API: GET /device.

local_ps_id.description: Filter by the local protection server UUID.

tools.name: axcient_get_device
tools.title: Get device
tools.description: Return one protected device by its id: health, thresholds, usage, vaults and jobs. Axcient API: GET /device/{device_id}.

tools.name: axcient_get_device_autoverify
tools.title: Get device AutoVerify results
tools.description: Return the AutoVerify results (automatic restore tests) for one device. Axcient API: GET /device/{device_id}/autoverify.

tools.name: axcient_list_device_restore_points
tools.title: List device restore points
tools.description: List the restore points of one device, grouped by the cloud vaults it is replicated to. Use it to check the latest recovery point. Axcient API: GET /device/{device_id}/restore_point.

max_timestamp.description: Upper time bound, as the API's max_timestamp parameter (integer).

tools.name: axcient_list_device_jobs
tools.title: List device jobs
tools.description: List the jobs of one device under one client. Start here to find a job_id. Axcient API: GET /client/{client_id}/device/{device_id}/job.

tools.name: axcient_get_job
tools.title: Get job
tools.description: Return one job by its id. Axcient API: GET /client/{client_id}/device/{device_id}/job/{job_id}.

tools.name: axcient_get_job_history
tools.title: Get job history
tools.description: List the run history of one job: status, start and end time, and error message per run. Use it to find failed backups. Axcient API: GET /client/{client_id}/device/{device_id}/job/{job_id}/history.

starttime_begin.description: Lower start-time bound, as the API's starttime_begin parameter (integer).

tools.name: axcient_list_users
tools.title: List users
tools.description: List the users related to the organization: name, role, active state and last login. Axcient API: GET /user.

tools.name: axcient_get_user
tools.title: Get user
tools.description: Return one user by its id. Axcient API: GET /user/{user_id}.

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with Axcient
prompts.description: What you can do with Axcient here, with example requests to try.

prompts.name: find_devices_with_failed_backups
prompts.title: Find devices with failed backups
prompts.description: The AI lists the protected devices and reads their job history. You see which backup runs failed, when, and the error message.

prompts.name: check_the_latest_restore_point_of_a_server
prompts.title: Check the latest restore point of a server
prompts.description: The AI finds the device by name, then lists its restore points grouped by cloud vault. You see when the last recovery point was taken.

prompts.name: review_storage_use_per_client
prompts.title: Review storage use per client
prompts.description: The AI lists the clients and reads each client's local, vault and cloud storage use. You see which customers use the most storage.

prompts.name: check_vault_health
prompts.title: Check vault health
prompts.description: The AI lists the vaults and reads their health status and connectivity threshold. You see which vaults need attention.
